class.name: BulletTargets2D
class.brief_description: Who a script's bullets and lasers aim at, without a spawner.
class.description: A target source made by code: [method from_group], [method from_node], [method from_children], [method from_name], [method from_positions] or [method from_mouse], filtered by [member filter_group] and the plugin's target filter (live [Node2D] in the factory's world, never a factory's or a preview's node), rescanned every [member update_interval]. Pass it wherever a target group goes: [method BulletVolley2D.graze_set_zones], [method BulletVolley2D.sound_set_effects], [method LaserVolley2D.graze_set_zones], [method LaserVolley2D.sound_set_effects], and to [method LaserVolley2D.track] and [method BulletVolley2D.homing_follow]. Every volley and laser armed with it shares its one target list: edits ([member positions], [member filter_group], [member update_interval]) reach them in flight, and they keep it after the script drops the handle. The list follows one factory's world: give the bullets of each [BulletFactory2D] their own handle (one handle read by two factories rescans at every switch). Spawners name the same sources in their Graze, Sound and Laser Targeting groups.

method.name: from_children
method.description: The [Node2D] children of [param parent] (all descendants with [param recursive]).

method.name: from_group
method.description: The live members of [param group] (also in [param filter_group] when set). An empty group is refused (null, one error).

method.name: from_mouse
method.description: The cursor, read every sweep in the factory's coordinates.

method.name: from_name
method.description: Every [Node2D] of the current scene whose name matches [param name] by [param match_mode] (0 Exact, 1 Contains, 2 Starts With, 3 Ends With).

method.name: from_node
method.description: One [Node2D] ([param node], read by id: a freed node is refused).

method.name: from_positions
method.description: Fixed points ([member positions], finite); a signal names a point target as [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_source
method.description: Which source this handle uses ([enum Source]).

method.name: refresh
method.description: Every list of this handle rescans at its next use (a node joined a group mid-interval).

method.name: resolve
method.description: The targets now as the bullets of [param factory] see them this sweep: nodes, or [Vector2] for points; a fresh scan of its world while it does not run yet.

members.member: An allow-list group for the node sources (empty = everything found counts); points and the mouse ignore it.
The points of a [method from_positions] handle (finite); set it every frame to move them: armed bullets test the new points at their next tick.
Seconds between membership rescans (0 = every tick, the default); positions stay live between them and a freed target drops at once.
